products.text:
Type: geometric jacquard throw blanket
Use: warmth and layering on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, contemporary, rustic
Materials: soft woven herringbone-textured fabric, twisted fringe
Colors: navy blue, cream, warm tan accents
Shape: rectangular, bold diamond and lattice pattern, tan stripe borders, twisted tassel fringe on the ends, flat, medium weight
Feel: graphic, cozy, global, lively
Goes with: white walls, warm wood, leather, navy or rust accents; bohemian or eclectic living rooms

Type: oversized ombre woven throw
Use: warmth and layering on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, coastal, modern
Materials: brushed chunky weave, fuzzy soft yarn, fringe
Colors: indigo blue, white, light blue heathered
Shape: large rectangle, ombre stripe fading to deep blue at the ends, nubby brushed texture, thick fringed edge, plush and generous
Feel: cozy, relaxed, soft, fresh
Goes with: grey or greige upholstery, white walls, light wood; coastal or modern living rooms

Type: brushed weave throw blanket
Use: warmth and layering on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, traditional, minimalist
Materials: brushed open weave, fuzzy mohair-like yarn, fringe
Colors: pale blush pink, soft white, light warm grey
Shape: oversized rectangle, subtle stripe, airy nubby texture, long soft fringe on the ends, light and lofty
Feel: soft, gentle, cozy, airy
Goes with: beige or cream upholstery, light neutrals, dark wood; traditional or soft contemporary bedrooms and living rooms

Type: faux fur throw blanket
Use: warmth and layering on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, rustic
Materials: plush faux fur, sculpted pile
Colors: frost grey, charcoal, warm taupe mottling
Shape: large rectangle, wavy sculpted fur pattern like pelts, thick plush pile, heavy drape, bulky
Feel: luxurious, cozy, warm, enveloping
Goes with: blush, cream or grey upholstery, tufted furniture, neutral walls; glam or lodge-style living rooms and bedrooms

Type: blackout curtain panels, set of two
Use: blocking light and adding privacy at windows; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: smooth woven polyester blackout fabric, rod pocket top
Colors: light aqua blue, soft cool teal
Shape: straight solid panels, rod pocket gathers, soft vertical folds, short sill-to-below length, plain
Feel: calm, fresh, restful
Goes with: white or cream walls, cognac leather, black rods, green plants; modern or coastal bedrooms

Type: light filtering jacquard curtain panel
Use: softening daylight and adding privacy at windows; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: farmhouse, coastal, contemporary
Materials: semi-sheer woven jacquard fabric, rod pocket top
Colors: white, slate blue-grey pattern
Shape: long straight panel, small diamond jacquard pattern denser toward the hem, gentle gathers, floor length, light and airy
Feel: airy, relaxed, light
Goes with: white walls, painted wainscoting, leather, whitewashed floors; farmhouse or coastal rooms

Type: curtain clip rings, set
Use: hanging curtains or drapes on a rod; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: matte black metal rings, metal spring clips, eyelets
Colors: matte black
Shape: round one-inch rings, small hook eyelet with spring-loaded clip below, slim and simple
Feel: practical, clean, understated
Goes with: black curtain rods, linen or cotton panels, white walls; industrial or modern rooms

Type: grommet blackout curtain panels, set of two
Use: blocking light and adding privacy at windows; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: smooth woven blackout fabric, metal grommets
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: straight solid panels, grommet top with even deep folds, short below-sill length, plain and heavy
Feel: dark, bold, restful
Goes with: white or light walls, cognac leather, black rods, plants; modern or industrial bedrooms

Type: sheer curtain panel
Use: diffusing daylight at windows; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: minimalist, coastal, contemporary
Materials: lightweight sheer voile fabric, rod pocket top
Colors: white, soft off-white
Shape: long straight panel, rod pocket gathers, translucent, floor length, light and airy
Feel: airy, bright, calm
Goes with: white walls, wainscoting, leather, light floors; coastal, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

Type: room darkening curtain panel
Use: dimming light and adding privacy at windows; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: modern, industrial, minimalist
Materials: textured woven fabric with linen-like slub, rod pocket top
Colors: medium warm grey, silvery grey
Shape: long straight panel, rod pocket gathers, soft vertical folds, floor length, subtle sheen, solid
Feel: calm, refined, restful
Goes with: white walls, brick, brass rods, warm wood; industrial or modern lofts and bedrooms
